{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== '''Exo Guard''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had high health but it walked at a below average pace. It also had 40% [[Defense]], [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], which made it harder to take down. ==Logbook Description== "''The Exo Guard was created by Righty as a precise replica for the Narrator's Final Act. Each button was carefully sewn on, along with other intricate details. However, because so many was needed to be made, Righty asked Lefty for help, but Lefty lazily refused. Because of the care Righty put into creating these guards, it feels resentment towards TDS for destroying them.''" ==Appearance== The '''Exo Guard''' is entirely covered up in black and purple armor, consisting of shoes, padding around thighs, shoulder-pads, shoulder-pads and helmet. On its arms, it has black glove and a grey padding on its arms. It also has a purple belt, a banner on its back and a button in the middle of its torso. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]], [[Warlock]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. *Towers which can reduce [[Defense]], like the [[DJ Booth]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to let your towers deal increased damage to it. **Towers which reduce [[Defense]] through freeze cannot be used, as the '''Exo Guard''' has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. *Due to its immunities, the '''Exo Guard''' is far harder to slow down. **Knockback and freeze cannot be used, meanwhile stuns will only slow it down. **Towers like the [[DJ Booth]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used, as they are fully or partially not affected by its immunities. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ExoGuardWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExoGuard.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ExoGuardIconIG.png|'''Exo Guard''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Exo Guard''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Exo Guard''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Exo Guard''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Performer]]|Wave 8|[[Exo Follower]] & Exo Guard|Wave 10|[[Spectator]]|Wave 12}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
